plan: A ninja tank who teleports to his allies anywhere on the map to protect them.
aSurveiller: His E (Shadow Dash). He dashes and taunts you: you attack Shen for a moment without being able to escape.
contrer: Dodge his dash (E): it taunts you.
Watch his R: he can join an ally anywhere.
His attacks are blocked near his blade (W): move away from it.

sorts.Q: Recalls his blade, which damages based on max health.
sorts.R: Teleports to an ally with a shield.
